title: Tatuerad · vila · två små rörelser (ser ned, vickar)
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: från och till ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. Two very small movements with a still moment between. First she looks down at the felt in front of her and up to the camera again with one blink. Halfway through she is exactly as in the first frame again and holds still for half a second. Then her head tilts a little to one side and comes back upright. She ends holding still. Her lips stay closed and her shoulders and torso do not move. Her hands stay exactly where they are. The green background, the shoe and the edges of the picture stay as in the first frame. The tattoos keep their pattern.
